records.title: Neuronal processing of noxious thermal stimuli mediated by dendritic Ca2+ influx in Drosophila somatosensory neurons

searches.query: 10.7554/eLife.12959 exact article title and author identity

updates.название: Neuronal processing of noxious thermal stimuli mediated by dendritic Ca2+ influx in Drosophila somatosensory neurons

decisions.notes: Primary eLife full text and figure descriptions checked; PubMed PMID 26880554 confirms identity. Local noxious heating uses an infrared laser; Figs. 1-2 report Class IV extracellular firing and dendritic calcium responses, and Fig. 5 links heat-evoked activity-pattern manipulation to larval rolling/avoidance. Figure-specific animal/cell counts must not be pooled. Calcium fluorescence is not electrophysiology, and larval escape does not establish subjective pain or human transfer.
